title: The Car Race
question: Which car was the winner in 1995?

meanings.usage: 指速度竞赛，如汽车比赛、马拉松等
作动词时表示参加竞赛或快速移动
指聚集在一起的一群人

meanings.meaning: 令人兴奋的，激动人心的
meanings.usage: 描述让人感到兴奋的事物，是动词excite的-ing形式
指比赛的终点或某事的结束部分
表示完成某事或到达终点
指比赛或竞争中的第一名
表示位置或时间上的落后
副词，修饰动词，表示动作进行的速度
表示不确定的大数量，后面接可数名词复数
表示持续站着的动作状态
形容词，表示与日本相关的
形容词，表示与德国相关的
形容词，表示与法国相关的
形容词，表示与美国相关的

exercises.prompt: “There be句型用于表示某地存在某人或某物，过去式分别用There was（单数）和There were（复数）” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: There was/were + 名词 + 地点/时间
options: Be动词引导的一般疑问句
exercises.explain: There be句型的过去式：There was/were + 名词 + 地点/时间：描述过去某处存在的人或物，注意there was后接单数名词，there were后接复数名词

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

exercises.explain: My wife and I were at the race. — 我妻子和我在赛场。

source.en: My wife and I were at the race.

grammar.title: There be句型的过去式
grammar.definition: There be句型用于表示某地存在某人或某物，过去式分别用There was（单数）和There were（复数）
grammar.structure: There was/were + 名词 + 地点/时间
grammar.usage: 描述过去某处存在的人或物，注意there was后接单数名词，there were后接复数名词

examples.en: There was a very big race in 1995.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were hundreds of people there.

grammar.title: 一般过去时（Simple Past Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态，动词用过去式
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.usage: 描述过去发生的事情，常见的过去式变化包括：规则动词加-ed，不规则动词需单独记忆

examples.en: The winner was Billy Stewart.
My wife and I were at the race.
She said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!'

grammar.title: 方位表达：on the left/right
grammar.definition: 表示在某物的左边或右边
grammar.structure: on the left / on the right
grammar.usage: 用于描述位置，常与standing、sitting等动词连用

examples.en: We are standing on the left.
The shop is on the right side of the street.

patterns.pattern: There was/were + 数量词 + 名词...

original.en: There were twenty cars in the race.

examples.en: There was a big supermarket near our house.
examples.zh: 我们家附近有一家大超市。

examples.en: There were fifty students in the classroom.

original.en: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
original.zh: 我们的朋友Julie和Jack也在那里。

examples.en: I was at the cinema yesterday.
They were at the party last night.

patterns.pattern: Don't + 动词原形 + so + 副词！

examples.en: Don't speak so fast!
Don't eat so much!

patterns.pattern: be + in + 编号 + 名词

original.en: He was in car number fifteen.

examples.en: She was in room number 302.
I was in bus number 7.
